rules: Package an existing product video; do not replace or invent its main footage.
Use only the user's confirmed facts and supplied transcript for claims. Do not invent product measurements, warranty, prices, sales numbers or customer evidence.
Opening title lasts at most five seconds; brand label follows only if the main video is longer. The separately selected brand outro plays without product overlays.

Existing burned-in subtitles remain in the source pixels. Preserve a readable embedded subtitle track, or use imported timed subtitles. Do not manufacture or proportionally distribute caption timings.
Use concise titles in the user's requested language. Only change the cover time when the user requests a specific moment; metadata is not visual evidence.
